subject.title: fix(cli-runner): sweep orphaned bundle MCP temp dirs at gateway startup

question: Should this PR permanently retain every legacy pre-ownership bundled-MCP directory for manual cleanup in order to protect queued runs during rolling upgrades?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades automatic reclamation of existing credential-bearing leaks for rolling-upgrade safety; tests establish the mechanism, but the acceptable long-term operator burden is a maintainer product and operations choice.

options.title: Accept rolling-upgrade-safe retention
options.body: Land the owner-aware sweep with the startup warning, accepting manual cleanup only for pre-upgrade legacy directories.

options.title: Add a supported cleanup path
options.body: Keep automatic startup cleanup conservative but define a separately reviewed, explicit operator/Doctor cleanup flow for verified legacy debris.

recommendation.title: Accept rolling-upgrade-safe retention
recommendation.body: Land the owner-aware sweep with the startup warning, accepting manual cleanup only for pre-upgrade legacy directories.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available evidence trail for the current lifecycle design and operational reproduction, though final product acceptance remains with repository maintainers.
